meta.description:
[[]#d3f2f4]Hybrid[[]] mod primarily built around a gradually branching campaign that expands in multiple directions.

The mod adds a new planet, [[]#f7e9af]Gelion[[]], featuring its own campaign, star system, research tree, and gameplay mechanics.
The planet offers over 90 blocks to research, 12 units [[]#ffd37f]each with their own unique abilities[[]], 13 campaign sectors, more than [[]#ffd37f]6 new mechanics[[]], and plenty of room for map creation.

On top of that, the campaign also stands out with absolutely [[]#e65c5c]BRUTAL[[]] visual effects. Every texture was made with care and dedication.

[[]#e65c5c]THIS MOD IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT![[]]
[[]#ffd37f]The current completion percentage is approximately 64%, with plenty of room to grow![[]]

Help me develop the mod! Join the [[]#768bff]Azimuth Discord server[[]] using the [[]#ffd37f]link in the README file on the mod's official GitHub page.[[]]

///////////////////////////////

Land on a [[]#c9c1eb]sub-cryonic[[]] terra slowly heating up beneath its [[]#e99696]unstable star[[]]. The celestial body is suffering from [[]#ffbe93]global warming[[]] — glaciers are melting, atmospheric pressure is rising, and temperatures continue to climb.
[[]#e99696]Exterminate the enemy faction[[]]. Turn the planet into a temporary source of raw materials. [[]#d1e3ff]Witness a world that will soon become[[]] [[]#506381]ash[[]].

If you enjoyed the mod, please consider giving it a star!
[[]#c9c1eb]Thank you for playing.[[]]
